## What Shren builds

- Durable multi-agent orchestration runtimes (PostgreSQL contract state, checkpointing, crash recovery, versioned rollouts), comparable to LangGraph and Temporal
- Hybrid RAG pipelines on pgvector + OpenSearch with query rewriting, source ranking, freshness controls, selective context packing
- Tool registries (MCP-style) with JSON-schema validation, scoped OAuth, retry policy, side-effect logging
- HITL approval surfaces: confidence-gated handoff, reversible operations, audit trails, escalation policy
- Eval harnesses with golden datasets, task-level scorers, regression suites, prompt versioning, failure taxonomy

## Selected proof points

- CentrOS: 3,980+ Vitest tests on main; in production at a 23-unit hospitality operation since Feb 2026 (guest comms, refunds, vendor invoices, compliance)
- Faire: $5M+ GMV via apparel pre-order initiatives across 3+ international markets in 6 months (Senior Frontend, 2021–2022)
- WEBTOON / AXED: 40M+ reads, 492K+ subscribers, IP rights deal with Wattpad WEBTOON Studios — book + 2-season animated TV adaptation
- Coursera: shipped iOS course-download feature lifting completion 20%+ across 24M+ learner base (2017)
